name: totp-tools
description: External TOTP consumer: exposes the totp@1 capability as the tools 'totp list' (labels + metadata, never a secret) and 'totp code' (the current 6-digit code of a named entry) - provider agnostic, it only touches ctx.totp

reportEntryMetadata.description: include the entry's issuer/account in a `totp code` answer (default true)
